en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "Indeed, the fragrance of Paradise can be perceived from a distance of five hundred years, but one who is disobedient to his parents and a cuckold (dayyuth) will not perceive it."
It was asked: "O Messenger of Allah (swt), who is the dayyuth?"
He (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) said: "The one whose wife commits adultery, and he is aware of it."
